description: Separate feature matrix for patient-selection enrichment, distinct from 8D mechanistic ranker. Focuses on enrichment signals: Liver-met site burden, Immunoscore-IC, and GuardantOMNI plasma pTMB. GENIE R20 supplies tissue panel TMB only — never label it as pTMB_guardant.

features.name: liver_met_burden
features.enrichment_signal: CO.26 PFS no-LM HR 0.54 vs LM HR 1.39 (P_int = 0.02)

features.name: immunoscore_ic
features.enrichment_signal: AtezoTRIBE: liver mets prognostic, not predictive, when immune infiltrate is high (P_int = 0.990)

null_contract.immunoscore_ic: If missing, do NOT invent from tissue TMB; leave null or use HalioDx/AtezoTRIBE only
null_contract.pTMB_guardant: If missing, leave null. GENIE R20 tissue_panel_TMB (crc_tmb_msi_matrix) is NOT GuardantOMNI pTMB. Do not enforce ≥28 threshold on tissue TMB. Do not copy tissue TMB into a pTMB column.
null_contract.liver_met_burden: GENIE public does not provide reliable liver-met burden; use IPD flags (PEAK/PRIME/PACCE)
